name: bliptalk-studio
description: Retro dialogue blip, Animalese and chiptune textbox sound generator for indie game devs.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.package:itch: vite build && cd dist && zip -r -q ../bliptalk-studio-itch.zip . && cd .. && echo 'Wrote bliptalk-studio-itch.zip — upload this to itch.io (index.html must stay at the zip root).'
